basics.name: Jorge Gil Garcia
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer | Node.js · TypeScript · ERP & E-commerce
basics.summary:
Full-Stack Developer based in Valencia, specialized in Node.js and TypeScript. At LÍNEA GRÁFICA, a Shopify Premier Partner agency, I am a core developer of the company's proprietary cloud ERP for omnichannel e-commerce, used in production by retail brands and franchises.

I work across the whole lifecycle: modeling business logic (inventory, orders, invoicing, B2B, multi-store), building real-time integrations with Shopify and PrestaShop, adapting modules to each client, and shipping it all with Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) on self-managed servers. I also build custom Shopify apps with Remix, React and Prisma.

Outside work I build native Android apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, following clean architecture and testing practices. I am currently completing a Degree in Computer Engineering at UOC and actively exploring how LLMs and AI can be applied to real business software.

I enjoy turning complex business requirements into reliable, maintainable software.

work.name: LÍNEA GRÁFICA - Shopify Premier Partner | PrestaShop Partner
work.summary:
Core developer of the company's proprietary cloud ERP for omnichannel e-commerce (Node.js + TypeScript), working across the full lifecycle: business logic, integrations, infrastructure and deployment.
ERP business logic: designed and implemented the domain rules behind inventory and multi-warehouse stock, orders and returns, invoicing and taxes, customers, B2B pricing, product bundles, gift cards and multi-store / franchise operations.
Integrations: built real-time, bidirectional synchronization between the ERP and Shopify / PrestaShop (catalog, stock, orders, customers) using REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and background job queues, with retry and error-handling strategies to keep data consistent.
Client customization: adapted and configured ERP modules to each client's operations, translating business requirements from consultants and merchants into technical specifications and production features.
DevOps: containerized services with Docker, deployed and maintained them on self-managed VPS infrastructure, and built CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions (build, test) and Jenkins (deployment) for automated, repeatable releases.
Shopify apps: developed custom Shopify apps and extensions with Remix, React, Prisma and PostgreSQL for Shopify Plus merchants.
Production support: diagnosed and resolved incidents in live environments, optimized synchronization processes and monitored system reliability.

work.name: Independent Projects
work.summary:
Self-directed full-stack development period, building a portfolio of backend services, web applications and interactive frontends that led directly to my role at a Shopify partner agency.
Backend & APIs: built REST APIs with Node.js, Express and TypeScript, including JWT authentication and user management on PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, and a MongoDB / Mongoose service containerized with Docker.
Real-time & networking: implemented real-time communication with WebSockets and worked through CORS, HTTP and web server fundamentals by building servers from scratch.
Frontend applications: developed React and Next.js applications with component-based architecture, state management, routing and third-party API consumption.
Interactive UI: created animated, responsive landing pages and product showcases with GSAP, CSS animations and Tailwind CSS, focusing on performance and mobile-first design.
Vanilla JavaScript: built geolocation and map-based apps, games and infinite-scroll interfaces, and wrote unit tests for JavaScript code.
Shopify: built my first Shopify apps with Remix, Prisma and the Shopify API, the foundation for my later professional work.

projects.name: Petti - Dog walks & health (Android)
projects.description: Native Android app to manage a dog's daily life: GPS walk tracking with a foreground service (works with the screen off, multiple dogs per walk), a daily journal, rule-based health alerts, vaccination records and reminders, weight history, nutrition calculator and nearby vet search on an interactive map. Privacy-first: no accounts, no ads, all data stored on-device. Built with a multi-module clean architecture (domain / data / design system) and unit-tested use cases.

projects.name: Miusika - Battery-efficient music player (Android)
projects.description: Native Android music player focused on minimal battery usage: background playback with notification, lock-screen and headset controls, queue, shuffle and repeat, drag-and-drop playlists, sleep timer with fade-out and a home-screen widget. Uses audio offload so the CPU sleeps while the screen is off. Every architectural decision is documented as an ADR.
